label: tinychannels-main is GPL-3.0 and no earlier synthesis names it, so every phase 011 wire-table citation is behaviour to mirror and never a file to copy from an MIT tree
The five vendored crates under openhuman-full are GPL-3.0 like openhuman-main, so tinyagents, tinyconnectors, tinymemory, tinyhumans-sdk and tinysecurity are design-only before their value is ranked

A local-time cron slot that does not exist or exists twice has no rule in the built runtime, in the plan or in the reference documentation, so a spring-forward night can silently skip a routine and a fall-back night can fire it twice

The activity grouping is a faithful lift of OpenBot's seven ids and order, and the reference's third entry kind (a check-in setting) has no analogue here, so a does:tell routine shows nothing under recurring until 002 schedule rows exist

Both of phase 002's tempting additions are already deferred with a citation and a reversal condition: the 20-enabled cap and the first-failure notice, so re-adding either contradicts a frozen decision
